title: Summit Club Guest and Family Admission Allowances
content:
Each visit to a Summit Club location carries a guest and family allowance that depends on the membership held within the Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships range.

| Membership | Most guests on one visit, free or paid | Guests entering free on each visit | Fee per guest entry not covered by an included guest or a guest pass (USD) | Family access | Children count as family when younger than | Children enter free on this membership when younger than |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Club Essential | 0 | 0 | 59 | No | 21 years | 2 years |
| Summit Club Individual | 2 | 0 | 59 | No | 21 years | 2 years |
| Summit Club Individual Plus | 2 | 2 | 59 | No | 21 years | 2 years |
| Summit Club Executive | 3 | 2 | 59 | Yes | 21 years | 2 years |
| Summit Club Corporate | 1 | 0 | 59 | No | 21 years | 2 years |
| Summit Club Lifetime | 3 | 2 | 59 | Yes | 21 years | 2 years |

## What the columns mean

- **Most guests on one visit** — the ceiling on guests entering with the member on one visit, whether they enter free or paid.
- **Guests entering free** — the number of guests who enter free with the member on each visit.
- **Guest entry fee** — 59 USD for each guest entry that neither an included guest nor a guest pass covers, the same on every membership.
- **Family access** — where it is part of the membership, the member's spouse or domestic partner and children younger than 21 years enter free with the member. The 21-year figure is the family age used under family access, and it has effect only on a membership that includes family access.
- **Children entering free** — children younger than 2 years enter free with the member on every membership.

## Notes distinguishing the memberships

- Summit Club Essential admits no guests (a ceiling of 0).
- Summit Club Individual admits up to 2 guests and includes none free; Summit Club Individual Plus admits up to 2 and includes 2 free.
- Summit Club Executive and Summit Club Lifetime admit up to 3 guests with 2 free, and include family access.
- Summit Club Corporate admits 1 guest and includes none free.
